title: Oven Glazed Saudi Dates Pudding
description: A sweet, bouncy pudding made from caramelized dates and a fragrant sugar sauce, finished in the oven for a glossy glaze and a hint of cardamom. It is entirely egg-free and perfect for energizing any meal.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a baking dish with parchment paper.
Place dates, butter, brown sugar, water, honey, vanilla and cardamom in the dish and stir until the butter is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Bake for 25 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes, until the dates soften and the sauce turns a golden caramel color.
Remove from oven and let cool slightly, then stir in almond flour and puffed rice until evenly distributed.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for another 20 minutes until the mixture is firm and the surface is glossy.
Remove from oven and cool completely on a wire rack; the pudding will set into a bouncy, chewy texture.
Slice into squares and serve warm or at room temperature.
Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
